[slide 1]
STH400G SERIES SWITCHES
DATASHEET
High Performance Data Center Switch
Version: V1.0
Release Date: 2024/9/29
Product Overview
The STH400G Series switches are designed on a domestic new generation switch chip which is carried on SerdesX Platform
With 32*400G high speed ports and rich features, these switches will perfectly meet the requirements of Metro, Enterprise, Data Center and Hyper converged infrastructure(HCI)networks
Key features of the STH400G Switches
MLAG which can build an Active-Active system to improve the reliability of the network links from single board grade to device grade
Implementing Vxlan and BGP protocols to build EVPN applications for data centers scenario
Switch-to-switch encryption using MACsec(Media Access Control Security)AES-CMAC
Precision Timing Protocol
Rich L2/L3 features like IPv6, OSPF, BGP, PIM, etc.
The STH400G switches provide redundant hot-swappable power supplies(AC and DC are both available)and 6 bays with field replaceable fan modules. Generally, airflow of STH400G Series is front to rear(AFO), but a customization of rear to front(AFI)airflow is also available
Table 1: Feasible PSU and airflow of STH400G
Items	AC	DC	AFO	AFI	Power Input	FAN
STH-32QC	◯	◯	◯	◯	2	6

[slide 2]
The STH400G switches support varied management ways including console port/in-band network ports/out-of-band network port
Support SNMP v1/v2/v3, Support CLI(Command Line Interface), web management, Telnet and FTP connection
Support OAM to make management more convenient
Support SSH2.0, SSL, etc. to ensure security of management
Visual WEB GUI
STOS allows you to quickly configure common configuration items using a visual WEB GUI, which lowers the application threshold for users
Table 2: Models of the STH400G Series switches
The SHT400G Series of high-speed switches consist of the following models
